prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1337; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with symptoms consistent with concussion, including headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. The mechanism of injury is well matched to the reported force and direction of the crash. Over the course of sixteen visits, care followed a typical progression of graded symptom monitoring, vestibular and cognitive rest with gradual return to activity, and targeted exercises for balance and visual tracking. Frequency of visits tapered steadily as symptoms resolved and functional measures improved. Imaging and neurological examination findings clearly confirm the diagnosis. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known from the patient's history or available records. Billed services correspond to the clinical care documented, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. The patient was discharged to self-directed activity with instructions to report any recurrence of symptoms.
